ad_hoc_choices: two SiLU hidden layers of width 512
1,200 supervised and 600 market epochs with mandatory convergence gates
0.3% full-native supervised plateau tolerance at the observed non-zero reconstruction floor
AAE cap barrier log width 0.10 and log standard deviation 0.35
date_weighting: mean quotes within each date, then mean dates

native_source_audit.optimizer_schedule_caveat: All rows shared one randomized batch order and cosine learning-rate schedule in the source calibration. Gradients and optimizer moments were nevertheless row-local because SparseAdam updated independent embedding rows and the native model had no shared trainable tensor.
native_source_audit.proof: The only learned tensor is sparse daily_raw_embedding.weight; the three SANOS tensors are fixed geometry buffers. Slicing dates cannot transmit 2025 quote values into a <=2024 row.

validation_2025_direct_native_ceiling.semantics: independently calibrated per-day native state; this is a SANOS geometry ceiling, not an out-of-sample encoder
